We are The_Alchemist, a Bangladeshi team, passionate about AI, climate science and agriculture. We are developing VaporPath, a NASA-powered farm resilience simulator.

• Hawarih Hawa: Team leadership, research and NASA data exploration.
• MD Rakib Hasan: Research and strategic planning.
• Md. Naimur Rahman Nahid: Software development and video editing.
• Rafia: Storytelling.
